import re

# Step 1: identify all indie-genre songs across all playlists and collect their artist IDs

# Login
passwords=apis.supervisor.show_account_passwords();
spotify_pw=next(p['password'] for p in passwords if p['account_name']=='spotify')
login=apis.spotify.login(username='ma_smith@gmail.com', password=spotify_pw)
access_token=login['access_token']
print('logged_in', bool(access_token))

# Fetch playlists (public + private)
def fetch_playlists(is_public_val):
    all_ps=[]
    page_index=0
    page_limit=20
    while True:
        page=apis.spotify.show_playlist_library(access_token=access_token, page_index=page_index, page_limit=page_limit, is_public=is_public_val)
        if not page:
            break
        all_ps.extend(page)
        page_index += 1
    return all_ps

public_ps=fetch_playlists(True)
private_ps=fetch_playlists(False)
playlists={}
for p in public_ps+private_ps:
    playlists[p['playlist_id']]=p
print('playlists_total', len(playlists))

# Gather songs and their artists from playlist entries
song_artist_ids={}
unique_song_ids=set()
playlist_song_map={}  # playlist_id -> list of song_ids

for pid in sorted(playlists.keys()):
    pl=apis.spotify.show_playlist(playlist_id=pid, access_token=access_token)
    songs=pl.get('songs', [])
    playlist_song_map[pid]=[s['id'] for s in songs]
    print('playlist', pid, pl.get('title'), 'songs', len(songs))
    for s in songs:
        sid=s['id']
        unique_song_ids.add(sid)
        artist_ids=set(a['id'] for a in s.get('artists', []) if 'id' in a)
        if sid not in song_artist_ids:
            song_artist_ids[sid]=set()
        song_artist_ids[sid].update(artist_ids)

print('unique_song_ids', len(unique_song_ids))

# Define indie filter using song genre field
indie_re=re.compile(r'indie', re.IGNORECASE)

indie_song_ids=[]
indie_artist_ids=set()

# Fetch each song's details to inspect genre
for i, sid in enumerate(sorted(unique_song_ids)):
    details=apis.spotify.show_song(song_id=sid)
    genre=details.get('genre', '') or ''
    if indie_re.search(genre):
        indie_song_ids.append(sid)
        indie_artist_ids.update(song_artist_ids.get(sid, set()))

print('indie_song_count', len(indie_song_ids))
print('indie_artist_count', len(indie_artist_ids))
print('indie_song_ids_sample', indie_song_ids[:10])
print('indie_artist_ids_sample', sorted(indie_artist_ids)[:10])
